interpretation: Citation, click and install are different metrics. Changes after publication are observational and do not by themselves establish causation. Do not score unobserved answers as passes. No engine account or automated AI/API test is required or used by the local audit.

rules: Separate website visits, store listing visits, install events, installing users and actual extension use.
Do not sum unique users across source rows.
Match property, attribution scope, filters, timezone, audience and seven-day period length before comparing.
Exclude only explicitly identified developer test traffic; unknown remains unknown.
Compute installing-user ratio only when the same population is confirmed.
No automatic AI/API calls; record real cited answers separately from referral traffic.
